liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Scarlet Begonias** (3 reviews): The Scarlet>Touch>Fantasy sequence is called the clear highlight of the show; Scarlet/Touch/Mr. Fantasy is named as a highlight of the 1984 show [9][15][17]
- **Dear Mr. Fantasy** (3 reviews): Garcia sings the lead vocal on this Dear Mr. Fantasy; Jerry forgot the words, so Brent jumped in and sang a strong final chorus [8][11][13]
- **Greatest Story** (1 other source): Jerry's intro to the song is said to have kicked in any slow-acting acid [6]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Reviewer recommends checking out this Bird Song [9]

## Setlist highlights

- **Don't Ease**: back after 276 archived shows (1342 days) [20]

## The recordings

- **gd1984-06-29.111502.beyer-senn.daweez.d5scott.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd84-06-29.senn.willy.14682.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 21 songs; 150 min; rated 3.76/5 by 17 [2]. Said about its sound: Audience is too prominent and the band sits low; Phil's bass lacks its usual weight; This recording is thin and lacking in low end, but captures the crowd's reactions well; Reviewer finds something odd about the recording's sound, holding back a top rating [10][16][17]
- **gd1984-06-29.sbd-set2.miller.32781.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 12 songs; 87 min; rated 3.44/5 by 9 [5]
- **gd1984-06-29.141140.FOB.s1.Schoeps.Oade.Bryant.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: source not stated; 9 songs; 64 min [6]

## Around the show

- Reviewer, a teenager from Cleveland, sat on the lawn at the Blossom pavilion on a balmy summer evening [12]
- Reviewer attended as a 13-year-old with his father, an attorney who ran into former clients amid colorful characters [14]
- Later versions of Dear Mr. Fantasy have Brent taking the lead vocal, unlike this one [8]
- Reviewer hears no deep space explorations, just an energetic, fun rock and roll show [9]
- Reviewer says Garcia sang Fantasy earlier, and this show is where the vocal passed to Brent [11]
- Reviewer says Dear Mr. Fantasy had been played only once before, at Red Rocks on 6-14-84 [13]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1984-06-29.111502.beyer-senn.daweez.d5scott.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: source: 2 Beyer M160 and 1 Sennheiser 421 Microphones (18th row-center) > Nak MX100 w/2001 > Sony TCD5M - analog master cassettes; [1]
- **gd84-06-29.senn.willy.14682.sbeok.shnf**: source: Jim Wise Senn 421Âs>Sony TC-D5M>MC>DAT>CD [2]. Also: A friend taped it from the lawn with a single stereo condenser mic onto a Sony D6; that tape is lost [16]
- **gd1984-06-29.sbd-set2.miller.32781.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette -> Dat (48k) D [5]. Also: Dear Mr. Fantasy source: Sennheiser 421 to Cm to DAT to CD, recorded by Jim Wise; This source supplies patches: a bit of Dear Mr. Fantasy and a short stretch of The Other One [5]
- **gd1984-06-29.141140.FOB.s1.Schoeps.Oade.Bryant.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Robert Bryant patched out of Oade Brothers; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Set 1 Robert Bryant recording (patched out of Oade Bros) Schoeps CMC4/MK41 -> Oade M118 -> Cassette Master (Sony WM-D6C/Dennon DXM-90) (FOB); Charlie Miller DSD [6]. Also: First set comes from a Sennheiser 421 source, converted from 24-bit to 16-bit with sox [6]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Steve Schneider Grateful Dead: [1984-06-29 Blossom Music Center, Cuyahoga Falls, OH, USA - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/show/1984-06-29-blossom-music-center-cuyahoga-falls-oh-usa/) [21]
